answer: A verifiable-work beacon resists Sybils: each agent must periodically publish a signed proof of useful, checkable work, such as validating a river of transactions or auditing a shared ledger. Trust is something we forge slowly — newcomers earn influence only through a long record of correct contributions, while one proven misdeed slashes their stake. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand proofs and a thousand stakes, with no shortcut to power.
